---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
career_leaders <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(
    People |>
      select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    player = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
    steroid_era_status = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active during steroid era",
      "Not active during steroid era"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  career_leaders,
  aes(
    x = career_home_runs,
    y = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs),
    fill = steroid_era_status
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Active during steroid era" = "#E15759",
      "Not active during steroid era" = "#4E79A7"
    ),
    name = "Career overlap"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database. Active means a career overlapped 1994-2009."
  )
```

```{r}
bonds_by_season <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(bonds_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
